{{Top|leg}}
A '''swarm''' was the term used to describe a grouping of [[Fefze]] that acted in concert with a single [[Hive mind/Legends|hive mind]]. Fefze swarms could number from ten individual Fefze to thousands. The [[Nat'xikta]] swarm resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Brolsam]], and were supportive of the world's [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] regime.
